$comment: French typography as macOS fr writes it (pile fr/macOS, Finder + AppKit + System Settings values, counted 2026-09-25): «…» primary with a U+00A0 no-break space inside (630 pairs, for example « ^0 », and 1 with an ASCII space), “…” nested (Mise de “^1” dans la corbeille), the curly ’ apostrophe (1,247 against 3 ASCII), and a U+00A0 before ? (172), : (181), ! and % (never U+202F, never an ASCII space). Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: a no-break space (U+00A0) precedes ; ! and ? (a value that is only the mark stays out)
a no-break space (U+00A0) precedes a colon (times, URLs, and ratios keep theirs tight)
a no-break space (U+00A0) goes between a number and % (42 %)
a multiplier spells out fois (4 fois), never 4x

hedges.why: a bracketed gender or plural ending (fichier(s), connecté(e)); use ICU plural/select, or rephrase
a slashed gender ending (connecté/e; /s is the per-second unit, and /le starts an article, so both stay out); name the object, not the person
a midpoint or dot inclusive ending (connecté·e, utilisateur.rice.s); restructure to vous or a neutral noun
a slashed article, pronoun, or contraction hedging an unknown gender; name the noun (le dossier {name}) or rephrase
a slashed elision (de/d’, le/l’) hedging a vowel-initial insert; put the insert after a preposition that never elides (dans, sur, pour, vers) or name its type
